thread:
lara: FYI found 3 outdated optkit snippets and a broken quant-profiles link in /optimize/guide. Docs CI flagged PR #4127. Who can triage?

miguel: I'll take it. Which languages/snippets?

lara: Python + Go batching examples and a TS embedding small case. The python call shape uses old client.generate(), needs OptKit migration. Link points to deprecated page.

miguel: Plan: (1) point quant link to /optimize/quant-profiles/v2 (2) update python example to OptKit API and show batching options (3) add tiny smoke test to render/compile snippets. Opening draft PR.

docs-bot: Draft PR created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4192 3 miguel. CI: pending.

tara: Happy to review Go. Ping when ready.

miguel: Pushed edits: python snippet changed to:
```python
from redwood import OptKit
opt = OptKit()
resp = opt.generate_batch([{"prompt":"Hello"}], batching_policy="latency-optimised")
print(resp[0].text)
```
Need to confirm exact arg names but this matches new OptKit intent.

zach: Suggest we show tradeoffs: use batching_policy='latency-optimised' in examples and mention int4 quantization caveat for quality-sensitive prompts.

tara: Go snippet update looks fine; added import path and defer Close() in review, plus explicit ctx usage.

miguel: Incorporated comments, fixed quant profile redirect, and added a docs smoke renderer that checks for `optkit` codeblocks (basic lint/format). Local CI on fork passes.

docs-bot: Staging docs build failed: broken anchor in guides/anchors.md line 78. @lara can you patch?

lara: Pushed tiny anchor fix and clarified when to prefer prefix caching vs full KV prefetch.

tara: :thumbsup: will review after CI is green.

docs-bot: PR merged: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4192 3 miguel. Release note: "optkit docs: update batching/caching snippets; fix quant-profiles link"

lara: Thanks all. Leaving a follow-up in the PR to backport to v1 site and add a dedicated-capacity sample test.
